disclaimer: Reference starters, not a complete landing-zone deployment. No tenant or cloud resource was provisioned to validate these examples. Review permissions, policy, region, costs, and rollback before running.

kits.title: Azure gateway network foundation
kits.purpose: Create a dedicated VNet, delegated data-gateway subnet, and a separate private-endpoint subnet.
kits.effect: The wrapper runs Azure what-if by default. Only -Deploy with ShouldProcess confirmation submits a deployment.
kits.notIncluded: No Power BI/Fabric gateway, capacity, VPN, private endpoint, DNS zone, firewall policy, or cross-cloud route is created.
prerequisites: Existing approved Azure landing zone, subscription, and resource group.
Non-overlapping address space and registered Microsoft.Network / Microsoft.PowerPlatform providers.
A supported gateway region/capacity plus network and security review.
checks: Compile Bicep and review what-if for the exact subscription/resource group.
Add actual source routes, DNS, TLS, storage access, and controls under network ownership.
Create the VNet data gateway separately and test service queries.

kits.title: Snowflake least-privilege BI serving
kits.purpose: Create an initially suspended, bounded BI warehouse and a reader role for one approved view.
kits.effect: Creates/updates the named BI warehouse settings and grants narrowly scoped read access. Creates no users, secrets, or OAuth integration.
kits.notIncluded: No row policy, Entra integration, resource monitor, or automatic assignment of the role to a user.
prerequisites: A reviewed existing view and authorized role/warehouse grant administrator.
Set the SQL variables to approved database, schema, and view identifiers.
Validate actual compute sizing and statement timeouts with the intended workload.
checks: Review existing objects before rerunning; named warehouse settings are deliberately applied.
Map the role to an approved identity separately; do not grant ACCOUNTADMIN to report users.
Add a separately approved resource monitor and test query totals/types.

kits.title: Databricks curated-view job
kits.purpose: Deploy an unscheduled SQL-file job that publishes an explicit daily aggregate contract.
kits.effect: Bundle deployment creates a job and workspace file. Running the job replaces the named sample view using an existing SQL warehouse.
kits.notIncluded: No workspace, SQL warehouse, source table, catalog/schema, BI grants, or production schedule is provisioned.
prerequisites: Authenticated current Databricks CLI profile and an existing SQL warehouse.
An approved run-as service principal with required source SELECT and target view-creation privileges.
Edit the fully qualified SQL source/target names and verify the documented source-column contract.
kits.command:
Set-Location .\examples\databricks
 databricks bundle validate -t sandbox --var 'warehouse_id=<warehouse-id>,run_as_principal=<application-id>'
 databricks bundle deploy -t sandbox --var 'warehouse_id=<warehouse-id>,run_as_principal=<application-id>'
checks: Inspect the resolved bundle and job run-as identity before deploy/run.
Run the job explicitly; reconcile counts/amounts and review the replaced view.
Grant consumers only approved Unity Catalog and warehouse privileges separately.

kits.title: Foldable incremental refresh filter
kits.purpose: Apply a half-open Date/Time window to a connector-backed curated fact table.
kits.effect: Filters an existing Power Query table. It does not create the parameters or the service refresh policy.
kits.notIncluded: No connector credentials, model, date parameters, refresh policy, or real-time partition is deployed.
prerequisites: Existing connector-backed query named FactSalesSource with an OrderDateTime Date/Time column.
Separate case-sensitive RangeStart and RangeEnd Date/Time parameters in Power Query.
A reviewed retention/refresh window and a connector query-folding test.
kits.command: Use the M expression in a separate FactSales query; configure the table refresh policy in Power BI Desktop, then publish and complete initial refresh.
checks: Verify OrderDateTime >= RangeStart and OrderDateTime < RangeEnd reach the source.
Test adjacent window boundaries, late-arriving changes, and time zones.
Enable a real-time DirectQuery partition only with supported licensing and an explicit requirement.

kits.title: Guarded enhanced model refresh
kits.purpose: Request a transactional enhanced refresh and optionally wait for that exact operation.
kits.effect: -WhatIf does not authenticate or make network requests. A confirmed invocation consumes source and capacity resources.
kits.notIncluded: No model publication, credential provisioning, license assignment, or deployment pipeline is performed.
prerequisites: PowerShell 7.2+, MicrosoftPowerBIMgmt.Profile, and a workspace supporting enhanced refresh.
Existing model, configured source connections, and appropriate API/workspace permissions.
Interactive Entra login or approved certificate-based service principal; enable tenant API access as required.
checks: Review the request with -WhatIf before using the script without that switch.
Accepted is not Completed: use -Wait and inspect operation state.
Test failure/timeout handling; a client wait timeout does not cancel a running service refresh.
